## Description

Uses recurrent neural networks with multi-head attention mechanisms in a reinforcement learning setup to dynamically schedule order liquidation while attending to multi-level order book depth.

## Where it may fit

Institutional block liquidation, minimizing market impact during changing limit order book liquidity profiles.

## Vehicles

Agency Execution Desks, Algorithmic Execution Brokers, Institutional Asset Managers.

## Required data

Level 2/3 limit order book message feeds, trade execution logs, historical volume profiles.

## Caveats

Attention map interpretability should be verified to ensure the agent does not overfit to transitory order book noise.
